drivers.label: Points added per pass
drivers.cue: Watch Syracuse's first few drives through the air: completions of 15 or more yards. If Syracuse does that often, Syracuse's offense is winning this matchup; if not, Notre Dame's defense is.

detail.meaning: Points added per pass: how much the average pass play moves the offense toward scoring, based on down, distance and field position. Above zero helps the offense.
detail.why: One of the 4 stats the model found actually decide games. Since 2015, the team with the better side of this matchup won 64% of the time.

drivers.label: Early-down success
drivers.cue: Watch Syracuse on 1st down: gaining 4 or more yards keeps them out of 3rd-and-long. If Syracuse does that often, Syracuse's offense is winning this matchup; if not, Notre Dame's defense is.

detail.meaning: How often the offense has a successful play on normal downs: every 1st down, 2nd-and-7 or shorter, and 3rd or 4th-and-4 or shorter, on any set of downs in a drive (not just the first two plays). Successful means gaining half the yards needed on 1st down, 70% on 2nd, and all of it on 3rd or 4th.
detail.why: One of the 4 stats the model found actually decide games. Since 2015, the team with the better side of this matchup won 66% of the time.
